scope.summary: Implement the high-to-low bake pipeline per Section 13.26 (GREQ-008/009): normal, AO, curvature, and displacement baked from the SubD+HD authority body onto the export mesh with bake groups preventing cross-projection, plus the optional pose/expression-driven baked morph/wrinkle normal maps for real-time skin folding.
acceptance_criteria: The bake pipeline projects normal/AO/curvature/displacement from the SubD cage + HD multi-res detail (MT-572 lane) onto the export mesh at profile resolution; outputs land in the manifest with budget checks.

Bake groups isolate projection regions (Marmoset pattern): a breast/arm proximity fixture and an inner-thigh fixture produce zero cross-projection artifacts (no arm detail baked onto breast, no thigh-on-thigh bleed).
The optional wrinkle/morph normal-map bake (GREQ-009) generates pose- and expression-driven normal deltas per the profile's wrinkle schedule, named and manifest-listed for engine-side wiring.
Bakes are deterministic at fixed sample counts (hash-stable outputs in test mode).
scope.risk_if_missed: HD detail — the open-HD differentiator against Daz's PA-gated .dhdm — never reaches any engine, and naive projection bakes smear detail across close-proximity extreme anatomy exactly where closeups happen.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit publishing and DCC interchange

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
